en: The image features sepia-toned portraits of a woman and a man. The woman is wearing an elaborate, large feathered hat and a light-colored dress adorned with flowers, reflecting early 20th-century fashion. The man has a styled mustache and is dressed in a suit and tie. Both subjects are formally posed and looking towards the camera, with the man turned slightly towards the woman. At the bottom of the image, the text 'Biblioteca Regional de Madrid' is visible.
